genius_advantages.point: Gives PAR a strong franchisee back-office foothold in Yum and RBI systems — overlapping Genius Back Office (RTI), which also serves RBI

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Delaget is a PAR product lineage and should be assessed with PAR OPS, not counted as a separate vendor.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Delaget is a PAR product lineage and should be assessed with PAR OPS, not counted as a separate vendor.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: PAR acquired Delaget effective December 31, 2024; PAR described more than 30,000 locations and launched PAR OPS combining its analytics with PAR Data Central.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Map Delaget-to-PAR OPS transition at named accounts, and compare operational analytics and loss prevention.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Acquisition-era site count is older than 18 months; present live sites and product migration need confirmation.
